M1.note: T: The available actions are just the 5 movement/undo actions and RESET. There are no other actions.

M2.note: T: In Sokoban, that's a dead state (the crate in the corner (2,0) can never be moved again).

M3.note: T: the crate's destination r is walkable (floor/marker/goal, no crate, in range).

M4.note: T: When on bright, can only step on bright (or the goal); when on dark, can only step on dark

M5.note: T: the goal {4} is accessible from any class

M6.note: T: The player stays on dark

M7.note: T: Therefore the crate must be able to cross classes

M8.note: T: crate onto blue marker = level complete.
